verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents stakeholder access to the platform (docs-6) and an admin setting that controls whether shareholders can see their equity value (docs-16), alongside vesting schedules for employees (docs-10). This implies a stakeholder-facing view of holdings, but nothing describes an employee portal showing grants, vesting progress or strike price. Waterfall and round modeling are positioned for leadership teams, not employee outcome modeling (docs-22, docs-19). Missing for 10: an explicitly documented employee portal, a vesting-progress display, strike price visibility, employee-facing exit/outcome scenario modeling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the employee experience.
